payload.leagueSummary: NET is the whole fight right now, and the window says the top end is split between complete-ball-striker monsters and the guys surviving by scrambling their way out of trouble. KeithK75 and Dan94 are the cleanest all-around threats, while CRANK keeps sneaking near the top with a game that looks like a bar fight: ugly off the tee, weirdly alive everywhere it matters. Below them, the league gets messy fast—too many players are donating strokes with the irons, the putter, or both, which means this place rewards whoever can keep the big number from showing up on the card.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the steadiest full-package profile in the window: elite approach work, real putter help, and enough tee game to stop the round from catching fire.
Dan94 owns the loudest raw golf, but the net battle is tighter than the gross one because the dude can absolutely launch it and still keep the whole thing together.
CRANK is the definition of rear-view-mirror golf: the tee game is a dumpster fire, yet the short game keeps bailing him out just enough to wreck the leaderboard in net.
